sloka: भो महेन्द्रेशवरुणप्रजेश्वरधनेश्वराः ।जानतामपि वः सर्वं वक्ष्यामि श्रूयतां हितम् ।। ७.३६.८ ॥
transliteration: bho mahendreśavaruṇaprajeśvaradhaneśvarāḥ ।jānatāmapi vaḥ sarvaṁ vakṣyāmi śrūyatāṁ hitam ।। 7.36.8 ॥

translations.english: Brahma addressed the gods, including Mahendra, Ishvara, Varuna, Prajeshvara, and Dhaneshvara, stating that even though they might already know, he would speak to them about something beneficial, which they should hear.
